description: Implement the 5 gym changes in gymapp.html, bump sw.js CACHE (and add gymapp.html to SHELL if appropriate), commit on main
steps: 1 Gym planner: add calendar showing workouts on the day they were done
2 Log: remove global edit and save workout buttons; add edit and save exercise buttons per exercise
3 Plate calculator: remove per exercise; one general main button inside the log
4 Prefill next session with previous session's sets and weights as-is, no suggested progression
5 Save exercise marks that exercise visually distinct/highlighted vs unsaved ones
findings: No plate calculator or edit button existed in gymapp.html; added a single general plate calculator button in the log and per-exercise Edit/Save exercise. Global Save workout removed (workout entry is created on first Save exercise). Prefill uses last session sets as-is (weight/reps; RIR left blank). sw.js CACHE forma-v40, gymapp.html added to SHELL.
